variant_note: Use the '-outline-rounded' name (or '-rounded' where the glyph has no outline form). Never sharp, never the plain filled form for a default state.
style_note: Material Symbols draws an outlined look as filled paths, so there is no stroke to retarget. 'filled' here is the geometry type, not the look.
established: 2026-10-01. Measured, not asked: the account-menu icons in design-kit/icons (action/settings, misc/help, action/edit-profile, brand/logout) match Material Symbols Rounded weight 400 glyph for glyph, drawn at the 20px optical size. The whole set audits as mixed (95 grids), so this pins the account/settings family deliberately rather than inheriting the most common value.
source_note: api.iconify.design is blocked from the cloud sandbox; the npm registry is not. Use fetch.py --source npm there.
